# Write social and community posts

Produce a post an account publishes itself, ready to paste, in the voice of the person or company
posting.

## Method

1. **Draft from the craft.** Make the decisions in the entry (`ENTRY.md`), then read the channel
   file for the platform in the library's `channels/` folder: `x`, `linkedin`, `reddit`,
   `hacker-news`, `product-hunt`, `facebook`, `instagram`, or `tiktok`. Compare the draft with that
   file's annotated pairs. The `tiktok` file has no annotated pairs or listed limits: skip the
   comparison, and confirm caption and length limits in the app before delivery. For a TikTok or
   Instagram photo slideshow, also follow [photo slideshows](references/photo-slideshows.md).
2. **Check after drafting.** Run [the check](references/method.md) on the finished draft: facts,
   first person, quote consent, limits, and a last read as the reader.
3. **Deliver.** The post first. Add only the pieces the job needs: an alternate opening when it
   tests a different angle, the reply with the link, a short reply bank for likely questions, a
   media or gallery brief. Then the operator note.

One platform and one market per post. For several platforms, write each one natively; never paste
the same body into every format.

## Edit mode

When the user supplies a draft, keep their wording, voice, order, and rhythm. Change only a failed
check, a factual error, or what they asked for, and name each change. If a hard limit needs a larger
edit, show the smallest change that fits.

## Missing input

If there is no person or account, no reader, or nothing true worth saying, ask before drafting.
Recommend not posting when the community and the product do not fit.

## Route elsewhere

Paid ads go to `ads`; landing-page and on-site copy to `copy`; DMs and one-to-one sequences to
`outreach`; full video production to `video` (this command writes the caption only).

## Approval

Publishing, scheduling, voting, replying as the account, and account changes need the user's
explicit approval at the time of the action. If the host cannot hold that boundary, stop at the
ready-to-post package.

## Review files

[Anti-patterns](references/anti-patterns.md), [rubric](references/rubric.md), and the specialist
roles are optional review aids for a launch package. They come after drafting and never replace
the check.
